summary: Reject invalid MCP request ids before tool dispatch

delivery.outcome: Reject invalid MCP request ids before any gateway, local cell or process dispatch; retain valid ids, notifications and subsequent requests.
nonGoals: No duplicate-id session tracking or interpretation of raw malformed input bytes
No source timing claim, dependency, schema, public interface, cell, budget or release changes
Preserve every existing assertion, timeout, finite-number and UTF-8 guard and no-replay behavior

architecture.decision: Validate id immediately after recognizing an id-bearing request and before params/route dispatch. Allow strings and mathematically integer JSON numbers (including integral floats); reject bool/null/containers/fractions with Invalid Request and null correlation. Keep missing-id notifications silent.
architecture.rollback: Reviewed revert of only this id validation guard and its regressions.

validation.evidence: Direct gateway/local cell/process and real child regressions reject nine invalid id shapes before dispatch, preserve exact positive calls, missing-id notification silence, valid Unicode/integer ids and same-process continuation.
Existing assertions and watchdogs unchanged; native Goal retains Python, actual TypeScript runtime and Rust gates.
Original accepted TypeScript function/package unchanged, zero new cell inference, all transport/TestQL/persistence/strict JSON/Unicode and request-id controls pass.

commands: native Goal author PR and protected exact-head publication
validation.evidence: Required exact-head CI, independent protected review/merge and native owner release/cleanup; no direct merge or closure commit.
